thresholdEvidence.notes: Public endpoint documentation supports the access chain, but no route-specific recreational flow cutoff was established in this pass. All eleven cards remain planning-only and use USGS 01081500 as an explicitly labeled proxy trend source.

endpointAudit.notes: Sewalls Falls, Bow/PSNH, Lambert Park, Boscawen, Canterbury Intervale and Riverland coordinates are taken from the access directory and municipal pages; each endpoint is named as a water-entry edge and retains carry, parking and private-bank caveats. The added pairs are distinct endpoint combinations within that same documented access sequence.
